note: Ranking fence hit is crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/mod.rs only, and every changed hunk is reached only when a root has a views-on semantic view (views.enabled, opt-in): the semantic lane then scores the checkout view's resident SemanticIndex through the same search_filtered as the legacy index, and reports missing files as a gap. The deleted view_semantic_search was the old views-on reader. With views off, ctx.checkout_semantic_runtime() is always None, so the default path takes the unchanged legacy branch and ranked rows must remain byte-identical to the committed reference.
